name.zh: 广告数据自动采集管道

scenario.en: The marketing team runs ads on 10+ media platforms and tunes budgets daily on spend, CTR, and CPA — the fresher the numbers, the better the calls.
scenario.zh: 市场团队在 10+ 个媒体平台投广告，每天要盯着 spend、CTR、CPA 调预算——数字越新鲜，预算调得越准。

pain.en: Data was pulled by hand from each platform's console and stitched into spreadsheets: 10+ hours a week, and at best day-old numbers — always making today's decisions on yesterday's data.
pain.zh: 数据靠人工从各平台后台导出、再拼进表格：每周吃掉 10+ 小时，而且最快只有「天级」新鲜度——市场团队永远在用昨天的数字做今天的决定。

now.en: Every hour the pipeline pulls from all platforms, normalizes and dedupes the data, and stores it in a database. The team self-serves on a BI dashboard — manual exports no longer exist.
now.zh: 每小时自动从各平台抓数据，统一格式、去重后存进数据库，市场团队在 BI 大屏上自助看数。人工导表这件事从此不存在。

role.en: Kicks off an ad-data pull every hour, on the hour — no human needed.
role.zh: 每小时整点自动启动一次广告数据抓取——不需要任何人手动跑。

impact.en: Data freshness went from daily to hourly; the numbers the team sees are at most an hour old.
impact.zh: 数据从「每天更新」变成「每小时更新」，市场团队看到的数字最多滞后一小时。

impact.en: No one runs scripts by hand anymore — that is where the 10+ saved hours a week come from.
impact.zh: 不用再有人手动跑脚本，每周省下的 10+ 小时就在这里。

how.en: On the hour, AWS wakes a small piece of code that does exactly one thing: tell the Fetch Layer to start pulling. Then it sleeps until the next hour.
how.zh: 到整点，AWS 自动唤醒一段代码，它只做一件事：通知 Fetch Layer 开始抓数据。做完就停，等下一个整点。

fail.en: If one run fails, that hour's data has a gap; the next run fires as usual — nothing cascades.
fail.zh: 某一次定时任务失败，这一小时的数据会缺一格；下个整点照常再跑，不会连锁挂掉。

n.en: Tells AWS: when there is work, run the function src/ingest.run.
n.zh: 告诉 AWS：「有活儿的时候，去跑 src/ingest.run 这个函数。」

n.en: This line is the timer itself. cron(0 * * * ? *) means: fire at minute 0 of every hour.
n.zh: 这一行就是定时器本体。cron(0 * * * ? *) 的意思是：每小时的第 0 分钟触发一次。

code.c:
// src/ingest.ts
export const run = async () => pipeline.start();

n.en: The only thing it does when woken: start the pipeline.
n.zh: 被唤醒之后做的唯一一件事：启动整条管道。

tourHint.en: Stop 1 · Starts the whole pipeline every hour — hourly freshness is decided right here.
tourHint.zh: 第 1 站 · 每小时定时启动整条管道，「每小时更新」就是它定的。

role.en: Pulls raw ad data from 10+ media platforms.
role.zh: 去 10+ 个媒体平台抓原始广告数据。

impact.en: 10+ platforms, each with its own way of connecting — the most maintenance-heavy part of the project.
impact.zh: 要对接 10+ 个平台，每家的对接方式都不同——这里是全项目最费维护的地方。

impact.en: If one platform changes its API, only that plugin breaks; the rest keep running.
impact.zh: 某个平台改了 API，只坏那一个插件，其余照常跑，故障被隔离住了。

impact.en: Adding a new platform means writing one new plugin from the template — nothing else changes.
impact.zh: 以后想加新平台，照模板再写一个插件就行，别处一行不用改。

how.en: One small plugin per platform, all the same shape: a single getData(params) interface (an API is simply an agreed way for two programs to talk). When the Scheduler fires, every plugin pulls from its own platform.
how.zh: 每个媒体平台一个小插件，结构完全一样：对外只有一个 getData(params) 接口（API 就是两个程序之间约定好的对话方式）。Scheduler 一触发，所有插件各自去自己的平台拉原始数据。

fail.en: If a platform's API is down or changed, only that platform's data is missing; the rest keep running, and the gap is backfilled next round.
fail.zh: 某个平台的 API 挂了或改版，只有那一家的数据缺失，其余插件照常跑；缺的部分下一轮补抓。

n.en: One file like this per platform — it registers who it is.
n.zh: 每个平台一个这样的文件，先登记自己是谁。

n.en: Every plugin implements the same getData — the rest of the code never cares how differently TikTok and Google behave.
n.zh: 所有插件都实现同一个 getData——外面的代码不用关心 TikTok 和 Google 的取法有多不一样。

risk.en: ⚠ This line makes a real API call and spends your quota on that platform. The rate limiter at the Redis stop exists for this line.
risk.zh: ⚠ 这一行会真实调用平台 API，消耗你在该平台的调用额度。Redis 那一站的限速就是为它准备的。

cost.en: Every platform's integration details are yours to maintain; when a platform changes, you patch.
cost.zh: 每个平台的对接细节都得自己维护，平台改版就得跟着修。

when.en: With only 2-3 major platforms and stable SDKs, SDKs are less work. With 10+ platforms and one unified interface, adaptors win — the case here.
when.zh: 如果只接 2-3 个大平台、官方 SDK 又稳定，直接用 SDK 更省事。平台一多、接口要统一，adaptor 才划算——现在是 10+ 个平台，所以选它。

tourHint.en: Stop 2 · Pulls raw data from 10+ platforms — the most maintenance-heavy part.
tourHint.zh: 第 2 站 · 从 10+ 个平台抓原始数据，全项目最费维护的地方。

role.en: Unifies each platform's differently-named fields into one standard JSON format.
role.zh: 把各平台叫法不一的字段统一成一套标准 JSON 格式。

impact.en: "Impressions" on the dashboard always means one thing, whichever platform the data came from.
impact.zh: Dashboard 上的「impressions」永远只有一个意思，不管数据来自哪个平台。

impact.en: However odd a new platform's fields are, changes stay inside this layer — nothing downstream moves.
impact.zh: 新平台的字段再古怪，改动也只发生在这一层，下游全都不用动。

how.en: Platforms name the same metric differently: some say views, some say impressions. This layer renames fields against one mapping table, then passes the data on.
how.zh: 每个平台对同一个指标叫法不同：有的叫 views，有的叫 impressions。这一层按一张对照表把字段名统一掉，再往下传。

fail.en: A field missing from the mapping table is skipped and logged — unrecognized data is never passed downstream.
fail.zh: 遇到对照表里没有的新字段，这条数据会被跳过并记进日志，不会把认不出的数据往下传。

n.en: The mapping table itself: platform names on the left, unified field names on the right.
n.zh: 对照表本体：左边是各平台自己的叫法，右边是统一后的字段名。

code.c:
export const normalize = (src, row) =>
  mapKeys(row, FIELD_MAP[src]);

n.en: The whole operation is one line — swap field names per the table.
n.zh: 统一动作只有一行——按对照表把字段名换掉。

tourHint.en: Stop 3 · Field names get unified here; downstream never cares where data came from.
tourHint.zh: 第 3 站 · 字段名在这里统一，下游不用关心数据来自哪个平台。

role.en: Drops duplicate data and throttles calls to each platform's API so you don't get banned.
role.zh: 去掉重复数据，并控制调用各平台 API 的频率，防止被封。

impact.en: The same ad record never enters the database twice, so report numbers don't inflate.
impact.zh: 同一条广告数据不会重复入库，报表数字不会虚高。

impact.en: No API key gets banned for calling too hard — one ban can mean days of missing data.
impact.zh: 不会因为调用太猛被平台封 API key——封一次，数据可能断更好几天。

how.en: Each record gets a fingerprint; Redis checks whether that fingerprint was seen before and drops it if so. Before every API call, the hour's call count is checked — over quota means waiting for the next hour.
how.zh: 每条数据先算一个指纹，Redis 查这个指纹出现过没有，出现过就丢弃。同时，每次调平台 API 前先查本小时的调用次数，超额就等到下个小时。

fail.en: If Redis goes down, the pipeline pauses rather than running unprotected — hammering APIs with no rate limit is worse than losing an hour.
fail.zh: Redis 挂了，管道会暂停而不是继续裸跑——没有限速保护地狂调 API，比停一小时更危险。

n.en: Dedup in three lines. NX means "write only if never seen" — a failed write means a duplicate.
n.zh: 三行完成去重。NX 的意思是「只有没见过才写入」——写入失败，就说明是重复数据。

code.c:
const used = await redis.incr('quota:' + platform + ':' + hour);
if (used > LIMIT) await sleepUntilNextHour();

n.en: Rate limiting is just counting: which call of the hour is this; over the line, wait.
n.zh: 限速就是数数：本小时第几次调用，过线就等。

a.en: Redis for dedup and rate limiting
a.zh: 用 Redis 做去重和限速

b.zh: 只靠数据库唯一索引兜底

cost.en: One more component to run — extra memory and operational overhead.
cost.zh: 多养一个组件，多一份内存开销和运维心智。

when.en: At small volume (a few thousand rows a day) a unique index is enough and Redis can be cut. At 10+ platforms pulled hourly, the volume justifies it.
when.zh: 数据量小（每天几千条）时，数据库唯一索引就够了，Redis 可以整个砍掉。现在是 10+ 平台每小时抓取，量级撑得起它。

tourHint.en: Stop 4 · Dedup + rate limiting — this keeps your API keys alive.
tourHint.zh: 第 4 站 · 去重 + 限速，保住你的 API key。

role.en: Stores the cleaned ad data and serves the Dashboard's queries.
role.zh: 存清洗完的广告数据，供 Dashboard 查询。

impact.en: Every number on the Dashboard is queried from here — if it's down, reports go blank.
impact.zh: Dashboard 的每一个数字都从这里查——它挂了，报表就白屏。

impact.en: Data is stored by day: "last 7 days" is fast, "all of last year" is slow. That's the current design's boundary.
impact.zh: 数据按天存放，查「最近 7 天」很快；查「去年全年」会慢，这是当前方案的边界。

how.en: Data cleared by Redis is written row by row into the ads_daily table; Looker Studio connects directly and runs aggregate queries (the kind that sums many rows into one number on a chart).
how.zh: Redis 放行的干净数据一行行写进 ads_daily 表，Looker Studio 直连这张表做聚合查询（就是把很多行加总成图表上一个数字的那种查询）。

fail.en: If the database is unreachable, the batch waits in a queue for retry — nothing is lost; the Dashboard shows stale data meanwhile.
fail.zh: 数据库连不上时，这一批数据先留在队列里等重试，不会丢；期间 Dashboard 显示的是旧数据。

code.c:
CREATE TABLE ads_daily (
  platform    text,
  ad_id       text,
  date        date,
  impressions bigint,
  spend       numeric,
  PRIMARY KEY (platform, ad_id, date)
);

n.en: The entire store is one table. The three-part primary key guarantees one row per ad per day — the last line of defense for dedup.
n.zh: 整个存储就这一张表。主键三件套保证「同一天、同一条广告」只存一行——这是去重的最后一道保险。

risk.en: ⚠ Changing this table's structure (columns, primary key) is the hardest thing in the project to undo — everything is built on it. Back up first.
risk.zh: ⚠ 改这张表的结构（加列、改主键）是全项目最难回头的操作——上下游都建在它上面，动之前先备份。

cost.en: Past hundreds of millions of rows, large aggregate queries struggle.
cost.zh: 数据涨到亿级行之后，大范围聚合查询会吃力。

when.en: When the team runs "two years, all platforms" analyses or rows pass 100M, move to BigQuery. Until then PostgreSQL is cheaper and simpler.
when.zh: 当市场团队开始跑「跨两年、全平台」这类大分析，或行数过亿时，迁去 BigQuery。在那之前，PostgreSQL 更便宜也更简单。

tourHint.en: Stop 5 · Where the data finally lives — every Dashboard number is queried from here.
tourHint.zh: 第 5 站 · 数据的最终存放处，Dashboard 的每个数字都从这里查。

role.en: Lets the marketing team see spend, CTR, and CPA directly — no SQL, no waiting for exports.
role.zh: 让市场团队直接看 spend、CTR、CPA——不用会 SQL，也不用等人导表。

impact.en: The team self-serves; you never manually export a weekly report again.
impact.zh: 市场团队自助看数，你从此不用再手动导表发周报。

impact.en: This part is bought, not built — zero lines of frontend code.
impact.zh: 这一块是「买现成」而不是「自己造」——一行前端代码都没写。

how.en: Looker Studio connects straight to PostgreSQL. You configure charts by drag-and-drop; it generates the queries.
how.zh: Looker Studio 直连 PostgreSQL。你在图形界面里拖拽配置图表，它自动生成查询语句去取数。

fail.en: When a chart errors, the problem is almost always upstream — check whether today's data is in the Database before suspecting the chart config.
fail.zh: 图表报错时，问题几乎都在上游——先看 Database 里有没有当天的数据，再怀疑图表配置。

tourHint.en: Stop 6 · The team self-serves here — the pipeline closes its loop.
tourHint.zh: 第 6 站 · 市场团队在这里自助看数，流水线到此闭环。

short.en: An agreed way for two programs to talk to each other.
short.zh: 两个程序之间约定好的对话方式。

short.en: A timer that runs a task on a fixed schedule — here, on the hour, every hour.
short.zh: 按固定时间表自动跑任务的定时器——在这里是每小时整点跑一次。

short.en: A timer that runs a task on a fixed schedule — here, on the hour, every hour.
short.zh: 按固定时间表自动跑任务的定时器——在这里是每小时整点跑一次。

short.en: A timer that runs a task on a fixed schedule — here, on the hour, every hour.
short.zh: 按固定时间表自动跑任务的定时器——在这里是每小时整点跑一次。

short.en: A very fast scratchpad memory used here to spot duplicates and count API calls.
short.zh: 一块速度极快的"草稿纸内存",这里用它来认出重复数据、数 API 调用次数。

short.en: A battle-tested database — the filing cabinet where the cleaned ad data finally lives.
short.zh: 久经考验的数据库——清洗后的广告数据最终存放的档案柜。

short.en: A short code computed from a record; identical records always get the identical code, so duplicates are easy to spot.
short.zh: 从一条数据算出的短代号;同样的数据永远算出同样的代号,一比对就知道是不是重复。

short.en: A short code computed from a record; identical records always get the identical code, so duplicates are easy to spot.
short.zh: 从一条数据算出的短代号;同样的数据永远算出同样的代号,一比对就知道是不是重复。

short.en: Deliberately slowing down calls to a platform so it does not block your account.
short.zh: 故意放慢调用平台的频率,免得账号被平台拉黑。

short.en: Deliberately slowing down calls to a platform so it does not block your account.
short.zh: 故意放慢调用平台的频率,免得账号被平台拉黑。

short.en: Making sure the same record is never counted twice.
short.zh: 保证同一条数据绝不被算两次。

short.en: Making sure the same record is never counted twice.
short.zh: 保证同一条数据绝不被算两次。

short.en: The standard language for asking a database questions.
short.zh: 向数据库提问用的标准语言。

short.en: Business Intelligence — ready-made charting tools the team uses to look at numbers without writing code.
short.zh: 商业智能——现成的看数工具,团队不写代码就能看图表。

short.en: Business Intelligence — ready-made charting tools the team uses to look at numbers without writing code.
short.zh: 商业智能——现成的看数工具,团队不写代码就能看图表。

short.en: A small add-on piece, one per platform here, all built to the same shape so they are interchangeable.
short.zh: 小小的外接零件,这里每个平台一个,长得一模一样所以可以互换。

short.en: A small add-on piece, one per platform here, all built to the same shape so they are interchangeable.
short.zh: 小小的外接零件,这里每个平台一个,长得一模一样所以可以互换。

short.en: The number of calls a platform allows you; run out and you are locked out for a while.
short.zh: 平台允许你调用的次数;用光了就要被关在门外一阵子。

short.en: The number of calls a platform allows you; run out and you are locked out for a while.
short.zh: 平台允许你调用的次数;用光了就要被关在门外一阵子。

short.en: Renting seconds of computing instead of a whole server — you pay only when your code actually runs.
short.zh: 不租整台服务器,只租"计算的秒数"——代码真正跑的时候才花钱。
